subagent_strategy.trigger: Missing DomainSpec coverage likely spans multiple pilot feature lanes with different owners: product spec, UI, tests, hosted Strava data/security, geometry, and parent integration.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Use role-bound sibling agents to audit the pilot feature surfaces in parallel. Each role checks a different DomainSpec artifact family and returns a receipt to the parent, which synthesizes the missing-spec backlog. Dispatch Spec only defines and validates this strategy; it does not execute the subagents.
context: One-shot success is hosted friend preview, not pilot-ready or engineering-ready.
The implementation target is projects/body-war/app/ as a new TypeScript app replacing Python.

Friend-facing MVP uses real Strava data, hosted public preview, managed storage/sealed secrets, existing Parque Taquaral pilot track geometry target, auto-accepted preview controller updates, and preview-only validation.

Current online MVP folder has DISCOVERY.md, ARCHITECTURE-AUDIT.md, and MVP-ONESHOT-FORECAST.md but no SPEC.md, TEST-SPEC.md, ui-spec.md, WORK-PACK.md, domain.md, interfaces.md, operations.md, states.md, or persistence/security spec.

roles.purpose: Define minimum preview validation coverage for login, activity fetch, submission, controller update, deployment callback, and no-secret leakage.
roles.owns: TEST-SPEC.md coverage findings and preview-validation acceptance matrix.

roles.purpose: Check hosted public preview, Strava OAuth, managed storage, sealed secrets, token storage, and friend activity privacy boundaries.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve launching the five DomainSpec audit subagents to identify missing pilot feature specs before WORK-PACK.md and implementation?

subagent_lifecycle.summary: Operator approved execution with message 'execute the strategu'. Five role-bound explorer subagents spawned, completed, were joined into parent synthesis, and were closed.

steps.name: X-ray Body War hosted-preview pilot context
stop_conditions: Stop if the one-shot decision gate is not PASS.
Stop if friend Strava tokens or private activity payloads would be copied into repository artifacts.
Stop if the route expands success beyond hosted friend preview without a new decision gate.

steps.name: Inventory existing DomainSpec artifacts and templates
stop_conditions: Stop if template references are missing or replaced with invented artifact shapes.
Stop if existing docs are treated as generated DomainSpec specs without checking required sections.

steps.name: Fan out DomainSpec missing-spec audit lanes
stop_conditions: Stop before spawning agents until the operator approves the strategy.
Stop if any subagent role claims implementation completion or pilot-ready status.
Stop if a subagent writes secrets, tokens, or private activity data into a repository artifact.

steps.name: Synthesize missing DomainSpec spec backlog
stop_conditions: Stop if the backlog omits a role receipt or leaves a missing spec without owner and next route.
Stop if the backlog requires implementation before WORK-PACK.md is written.

steps.name: Validate dispatch and hand off to WORK-PACK planning
stop_conditions: Stop if dispatch validation returns block.
Flag but do not execute subagents if authorization remains requires_user_permission.
Next route is WORK-PACK planning, not implementation, until the missing-spec backlog exists.

gates.condition: projects/body-war/docs/decisions/parque-taquaral-online-mvp-oneshot.md records Result: PASS, Decisions resolved: 9, Blockers remaining: 0.
Subagent fanout is recommended but must not execute until the operator approves the five DomainSpec audit roles.
No Strava tokens, secrets, or private friend activity payloads may be written into repository docs or observability signals.
The coverage audit must classify each hosted-preview feature lane against SPEC.md, TEST-SPEC.md, ui-spec.md, work-pack.md, and required supporting DomainSpec aspect docs.
This dispatch may recommend missing specs and a WORK-PACK route; it must not claim implementation completion, pilot-ready status, canonical DomainSpec promotion, or Strava validation proof.
The route must validate with arcanum/formulae/dispatch-spec/scripts/validate-dispatch.py before use.

boundaries.contract: Subagents audit missing DomainSpec coverage and return receipts only; parent owns synthesis and no subagent implements code.
External friend activity data may be summarized as requirements but not copied into repository artifacts; tokens and secrets stay in hosted managed storage.
DomainSpec templates define artifact shape; generated Body War feature docs remain project-local artifacts, not canonical DomainSpec method promotion.

authority.memory: Craft ledger and Body War docs only through explicit follow-up updates

state_namespaces.write_policy: May write dispatch and future coverage/backlog artifacts only; no secrets or raw friend activity payloads.
Stores Strava client secret and token material outside the repository.
May be used through runtime APIs; repository artifacts store only redacted summaries and requirements.

promotion_splits.rule: Subagent audit evidence cannot automatically promote or alter canonical DomainSpec methods; project-local docs may only reference templates and source authorities.

promotion_guardrails: Do not claim pilot-ready status; the selected success label is hosted friend preview.
Do not claim engineering-ready status; selected validation is preview-only.
Do not promote generated Body War specs into canonical DomainSpec methods.
Do not implement or delete Python app files from this dispatch.
Do not store Strava secrets, tokens, or private friend activity data in repository artifacts.
